lines.zh: 罩袍扫过草地，绿得扎眼。
lines.en: My green surcoat sweeps the grass.
Sword left, shield right, I walk between.
The plate skirt chafes my shin.
One lap of camp to check the fence.
My stride is steadier than the banner.
Green camp's ground — I walk it all.

lines.zh: 走过泥地，靴子沉了半斤。
lines.en: Crossed the mud, boots half a pound heavier.
You ahead — clear my path.

lines.zh: 我走走停停，听林子动静。
lines.en: I walk, stop, and listen to the woods.

lines.zh: 这面盾陪我走过三个营地。
lines.en: This shield's seen three camps with me.
My green surcoat sweeps across the stone steps.

lines.zh: 踩断的树枝，我一脚踢开。
lines.en: Snapped branch — kick it aside.

lines.zh: 盔甲上的绿漆蹭掉一角。
lines.en: A chip of green paint off my armor.
I walk torch to torch, spacing even.

lines.zh: 站在这儿，正好看住路口。
lines.en: From here I see the whole crossing.
The sun bakes my surcoat hot.
The wrap on my hilt needs replacing.
Wind slaps the green banner.

lines.zh: 我盯着篱笆外那片阴影。
lines.en: I watch that shadow past the fence.

lines.zh: 站久了，脚趾在靴里发麻。
lines.en: Long standing numbs my toes.
Camp's strangely quiet today.
Someone's grinding a blade — steady rhythm.
I tap the shield against the ground.

lines.zh: 这面盾上的凹坑有名字。
lines.en: Every dent on this shield has a story.
Counting the crows that pass.
A stool would be nice about now.
Leaning on the wall saves half my strength.
Green blends well in these woods.
Distant sharpening, very regular.
One more moment and the watch changes.
Halt — push back that hood.
You look like you came from the south.
Green camp. State your purpose.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上有林子里的苔。
lines.en: Moss from the woods on your boots.
Keep your hands off your belt.
Do I know that face?

lines.zh: 一个人走夜路，胆子不小。
lines.en: Walking alone at night — bold.
One step closer and the shield comes up.
This armor isn't decoration.

lines.zh: 你是来送信的，还是来找打的？
lines.en: A message, or a beating?
Speak plainly and I'll let you pass.
Don't stand on my sword side.
Wet cloak — crossed a river?
Camp doesn't keep outsiders overnight.
The shield caught it, my wrist still numb.
A tear in my surcoat.
Spit blood, plant my feet.
That cut opened my shoulder plate.
A step back to reset my guard.
Hurts too much to grip the sword.
I can still raise this shield.
The plates ring. I'm still here.
Stay back — I've one trick left.
Bite down, don't let them see.
Ale? Or am I imagining it.

lines.zh: 炖锅里放了什么，闻着不错。
lines.en: What's in that pot? Smells good.
I eat after the watch. Don't rush.
One cup and I'll speak for you.
Walnuts in that basket, aren't they.
That smell wakes me better than the horn.

lines.zh: 先放桌上，我交了班再来。
lines.en: Leave it on the table, I'll come after.
Who roasted that chicken? Hold up.
My stomach's growling inside the plate.
A little salt is all I need.
My shield hit first. Sorry.
Don't shove, this gate fits one.
You hit my scabbard.
Move aside, I turn slow.
Knocked my surcoat crooked.
Steady — iron on iron isn't gentle.

lines.zh: 你从右边撞过来，我看得见。
lines.en: You came from my right. I saw.
Hands off my shield strap.
I give half a step and there's room.
Shove again and I turn the shield sideways.
Green camp's rules are harder than steel.
My oath isn't finished yet.
Let me get out of this armor first.
When there's peace, I'll think of a home.
The captain would scowl at that.
There's still mud on my surcoat.
Not unwilling, just no time.
Such words belong by a campfire.
Ask the green banner's leave first.
Not here — the wall has eyes.
A broken sword — can be reforged.
That buckle's mine.
Arrows — I'll take them to the archer.
A whetstone on the ground.
Dropped bracer — I'll keep it.
Dry bread, into the pouch.
This cord will strap my shield.
Iron scrap clinks into my pocket.
Don't grab it — soldiers are poor too.
This dented helm can serve as a bowl.
I see him — the one behind the tree.
Shield up, let's see if he dares.
He's holding an axe. Bad intent.
No blood at the green gate.
Marked him — pushing to his flank.
Keep him off the back of the camp.
Just one. I can handle it.
The banner fell — he's right there.
Feet planted. Let him come.
I'll remember this fight.
He's feinting left.
I follow his shield.
Counting the gaps in his breath.
One step more and the sword's out.
He won't strike first. I will.
That stone at the wall trips people.
He's retreating — I won't chase far.
Point on his chest.
I watch the sand at his feet.
He's breathing harder than me.
Steel out — the green flag stands!
A slanting cut, this one.
Shield to the chest, then cut.
Good guard — but your hands are low.
Break the gap, step back, cut again.
My blade's heavy. Don't block flat.
That one's for the fence.
He dropped his weapon — now.
Rap his fingers with the flat.
Recover and cover my flank.
Green flag up — I don my armor.

lines.zh: 从营地门出来，剑已出鞘。
lines.en: Out the camp gate, sword drawn.

lines.zh: 我守在营火与大门之间。
lines.en: I stand between fire and gate.

lines.zh: 这身绿罩袍是队里发的。
lines.en: The green surcoat is squad issue.
Shield on the left arm, feet set.
Another night watchman arrives.

lines.zh: 我接过哨位，也接过责任。
lines.en: I take the post and the duty with it.
Someone called assembly — I ran over.
Still got hay in my boots.

lines.zh: 营地的狗朝我叫了两声。
lines.en: The camp dog barked twice at me.
My green surcoat's on fire — can't beat it out.

lines.zh: 从墙头摔下来，盾先落地。
lines.en: Off the wall — the shield landed first.

lines.zh: 这身甲在水里只会拉我下去。
lines.en: This armor only pulls me down in water.
The blast dented my shield face.

lines.zh: 背上中了一箭，穿甲不深。
lines.en: An arrow in my back — didn't pierce deep.
Spellfire burns through my seams.
Two days unfed, the sword wavers.
Lightning ran down my blade into me.
The ground's gone — the armor falls fastest.
